decision: Main builds may continue updating latest.
constraints: Coordinate main and release registry writes, separate candidate tags and prevent older source commits from replacing newer latest.
Promote the checked digest without rebuilding; keep verification gates.
No publication is authorized by this decision.

The managed release workflow is locally adapted for this approved Tuniku channel policy. Manifest and kit lock retain both upstream and installed SHA256 provenance; all checksum checks and release gates remain enforced. A future kit sync must review the intentional workflow conflict.
